'''Mount Vorena''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]].

==Description==
Mount Vorena was the highest mountain on Volik and pockets of [[mumau root]] grew on the side of it. A river made of melting icecaps flowed down the mountain, ending in a waterfall known as [[Jolee Falls]].<ref name=":Mask of Darth Nihilus" />

==History==
Mount Vorena was named after [[Vorena]], the wife of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dorin Se'ol]]. Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Vorena, Se'ol climbed to the top of the mountain, to meditate. The mountain later became a site of pilgrimage for other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who would climb the peak to try and make contact with the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghosts]] of their loved ones.<ref name=":Mask of Darth Nihilus" />
